propositions: When a bug is closed as duplicate without a recorded duplicates link, the gate falls through to LLM completion verification which fails with no actionable remediation; the required 'rebar link <id> <canonical> duplicates' command is never mentioned.

The close gate must hard-fail before any LLM call for --class duplicate with no replacement link, raising CommandError with the exact link command, scoped only to duplicate (not not_a_bug or escalated).
The gate must require link EXISTENCE only, not target openness; closing a duplicate of an already-closed canonical is valid and must proceed via disposition verdict.
A dead/archived replacement target named in a duplicates link must produce a distinct error message from the no-link case, directing the operator to re-link to a live canonical.
The hard-fail check must run after --force early return and after bug_close_class_ok validation, preserving --force bypass and catching invalid --class errors first.
Existing tests for disposition attestation (738a) and fallthrough paths (not_a_bug, escalated, non-disposition classes) must remain unchanged, confirming the scope is isolated to duplicate closes.
